Priya S: Heads up — candidate (UK) for Senior ML Infra. Offer ready but payroll/tax + comp band exception needed. Can we discuss routing? cc @Jasmine P @Carlos F
Jasmine P: Thanks Priya. What's the requested comp band delta and sign-on? Any visa/relocate elements?
Priya S: Requested base is band 5 -> band 6 uplift (+12% base), + one-time sign-on GBP 8,000. No visa; candidate already UK-based but relocating cities within UK. Need clarity on tax gross-up and payroll region. Offer doc: https://redwood-offers/xyz (internal)
Carlos F: Quick take — we generally avoid gross-ups. For UK hires we can structure sign-on as "relocation allowance" vs. cash to optimize tax. Need payroll start date to confirm withholding impact.
Liam G: Can approve provisional comp exception to band 6 for this hire pending comp committee sign-off. Jasmine, please route to comp-committee with numbers and rationale. I won't block. :+1:
Jasmine P: On it. I'll open the exception request. Required artifacts: offer PDF, candidate scorecard, manager justification, and finance/tax recommendation (Carlos). Will add legal if cross-border nuance.
Carlos F: Adding finance recommendation: prefer structuring sign-on as "one-off relocation stipend" paid after 60 days, capped at GBP 8,000. That avoids gross-up and reduces employer NI exposure. Also propose payroll start: first Monday of next month to align with tax period.
Priya S: Sounds reasonable. Manager prefers earlier start (2 weeks) — can we make payroll adjustments if they start sooner?
Carlos F: If earlier start (mid-period) payroll can run prorated but it's messy for tax reports. We can still do it, but sign-on needs to be paid after 60 days regardless.
Jasmine P: Routing now — submitting with summary: "Band uplift for retention of senior infra hire; sign-on reclassified to relocation stipend; payroll start preference first Monday; legal review requested." Attaching docs.
legal-bot: Legal review requested for thread 2476509123. Assigned to @legal-team-uk. Estimated turnaround 48 hours.
Liam G: Thanks team. Once committee approves, Priya please confirm final start date and I'll sign off on the deviation.
Priya S: Will confirm with candidate today and update thread. Thanks everyone. :pray:
